title: Zulu legend that the moon brought us out of the Younger Dryas

tellings.quote: And there's actually a Zulu legend that the moon brought us out of the younger dus and that it it it it made the the climate stable on Earth.

plain: The Zulu people of southern Africa are said to have a legend that the moon brought humanity out of the Younger Dryas, a sudden return to ice-age cold near the end of the last ice age, and steadied Earth's climate. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, in an episode with the writer Randall Carlson about the idea that the moon is an alien spaceship. If true, it would mean an old legend remembers the moon acting on purpose to save life on Earth.
